title: Blue Haven | KEY.co
description_expanded: Indulge in a fully stocked kitchen, unwind in the living area with wrap-around windows, or enjoy endless fun in the detached game room packed with arcade classics. Outdoor amenities include a private dock, kayaks, a fire pit, a hot tub, and a festive patio terrace designed for dining and relaxation. With thoughtful touches like high-end toiletries, child-friendly amenities, and an EV charging station, every detail is tailored for an unforgettable stay. This isn't just a vacation home—it's the ultimate lakeside experience. Book now and make your dream getaway a reality! Our stay at Blue Haven was nothing short of spectacular. The design of the home felt so unique and well thought out. Those windows in the main living space are the perfect way to incorporate the gorgeous lake views inside while cooking, enjoying meals with family and relaxing in the spacious living room. Even on a rainy day, you can enjoy the lovely view from inside. Plenty of space for multiple families to enjoy privacy while winding down for a nap or bedtime. The yard was thoroughly enjoyed by the pup too!
